purpose: Map swarmVine gossip + skunkBat immune + thymus sort as the negative QS detection/response system

swarmVine.negative_qs: Spreads state every 30 sec to 0 peers. Pure dark_signal. Like bacteria producing autoinducer in an empty dish.
swarmVine.fix: ADD PEERS. golgi + graftGate need swarmVine instances. Gossip needs an audience.

skunkBat.role: IMMUNE DEFENSE — antibodies + scatter + threat response
skunkBat.negative_qs: Antibody confidence DECAYS over time (0.95/day). No new threats → all antibodies weaken → immune amnesia. Scatter generator idle → no poison produced → scrapers get real data.

code.antibodies.rs: Pattern memory with confidence decay. FleetAntibody lifecycle: detect → insert → match → decay → prune. Antibodies below threshold are PRUNED (fossilized!).
code.scatter.rs: Anti-AI defense. Generates FAKE Gitea pages to poison scraper training data. Deterministic from (seed, path). The defense IS misinformation.
code.gossip_analysis.rs: Pre-accept validation of swarmVine gossip. Verdict: allow/warn/block. GossipEntryParams checks: topic, ttl, version, expiry.

skunkBat.fix: STIMULATE. Send test threats. Run monitoring_loop. Connect to swarmVine gossip feed. The immune system needs antigens to stay sharp.

thymus.role: SORT SELF/NON-SELF — the gate between inside and outside
thymus.status: Data pipeline defined, not active as running service
thymus.pipeline: visit → klein gate → thymus sort → opsonize tag → pollinate → backscatter → colonize/eject
thymus.negative_qs: No visits → no sorting → no opsonization → immune system never trains. Like a thymus with no T-cells to educate.
thymus.code: Pipeline definition in thymus-gate.json. Connects to skunkBat antibodies + swarmVine gossip.
thymus.fix: FEED TRAFFIC. Every neutrino message, every web visit, every API call should flow through thymus sort.

negative_qs_in_immune.insight: ALL THREE exhibit negative QS when unstimulated. The immune system WEAKENS in silence, just like the printer wastes ink.
negative_qs_in_immune.antibody_decay: Confidence decays 5%/day. After 20 days of no threats, antibodies are at 36% confidence. After 60 days, pruned. The immune system FORGETS.
negative_qs_in_immune.gossip_silence: 0 peers → 0 responses → swarmVine burns CPU gossiping to void
negative_qs_in_immune.thymus_atrophy: No input → no training → T-cells never learn self from non-self → autoimmune risk (false positives) or infection risk (false negatives)
negative_qs_in_immune.biological_parallel: Real thymus INVOLUTES (shrinks) with age. Less stimulation → smaller thymus → weaker immune training. Exactly what's happening here.

connection_to_dark_signal.gossip_void: broadcasting to nobody = autoimmune (attacking self for lack of other)
